# Why did my AWS bill go up?

> Paste the CSV from AWS Cost Explorer for two months and see which services explain the rise in your AWS bill, ranked, with partial-month normalisation and a checklist of common causes. Free, no signup, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
